newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai PTTEP says may invest in Natuna gas field.
newsitem.headline: Thai PTTEP says may invest in Natuna gas field.

text.p: Thailand's PTT Exploration and Production Plc said it was likely to invest in the Indonesian Natuna Gas Project if its parent, state-run Petroleum Authority of Thailand (PTT), decided to buy gas from Natuna.
If PTT Exploration and Production decided to invest in the project, it would want to acquire a "substantial" stake, PTTEP president Prajya Phinyawat told Reuters in an interview.
"Normally, we don't invest in small stakes. We usually hold more than 10 percent of shares in each project. There is only one project in which we hold only five percent," he said.

The Natuna Field is one of the largest natural gas fields in the world. It contains an estimated 222 trillion cubic feet of gas, of which 46 trillion cubic feet are thought to be commercially recoverable..
The Field is located in the Natuna Sea, about 225 km (135 miles) northeast of Natuna Island in Indonesian waters.
Exxon has a 50 percent stake in the project and Mobil Corp 26 percent while Pertamina, Indonesia's national oil and gas company hold the rest.
Some Japanese companies are discussing taking shares in the project.
Prajya refused to speculate if the PTT would buy natural gas from Natuna but said negotiations were continuing.
"I'm not in the position to give further comment on that...but we are also studying if the project is worth investing in," he said.
Thailand consumes around 147,660 barrels of oil per day.

PTT sources have said that before deciding to buy it was weighing the advantage of the low price of gas from other fields in neighbouring countries compared to the long-term security of supply offered by gas from Natuna.
"I don't know if PTT will decide to buy. Natural gas from the Natuna will have price disadvantages compared to that from immediate neighboring countries like Malaysia or Burma," he said.
"But the operator of the project tried to sell the aspect of long-term security which this huge project can definitely offer," he added.
